overview.en: The Coscoroba is a small, distinctive South American swan-like waterfowl placed in its own genus, Coscoroba.
overview.fr: Le coscoroba est un oiseau d’eau sud-américain de petite taille, à l’allure de cygne, classé dans son propre genre, Coscoroba.

identification.en: Adults are white with black primary tips and a red bill, and are smaller and shorter-necked than the larger swans.
identification.fr: L’adulte est blanc, avec le bout des rémiges noires et le bec rouge ; il est plus petit et son cou est plus court que celui des grands cygnes.

habitat.en: It uses shallow freshwater lagoons, marshes and lakes with abundant vegetation, and can also occupy some coastal wetlands.
habitat.fr: Il fréquente les lagunes peu profondes, marais et lacs d’eau douce riches en végétation, ainsi que certains milieux humides côtiers.

diet.en: It feeds mainly on aquatic plants and small invertebrates by dabbling or wading, and also grazes on nearby pasture.
diet.fr: Il mange surtout des plantes aquatiques et de petits invertébrés en barbotant ou en marchant dans l’eau, et broute aussi les pâtures voisines.

behavior.en: It often feeds in shallow water without upending as frequently as other swans, and may gather in pairs or small groups outside breeding.
behavior.fr: Il se nourrit souvent en eau peu profonde sans basculer aussi souvent que les autres cygnes, et peut se rassembler en couples ou petits groupes hors reproduction.

reproduction.en: Breeding is concentrated in the southern part of its South American range, while seasonal movements farther north remain incompletely known.
reproduction.fr: La reproduction se concentre dans le sud de son aire sud-américaine, tandis que les déplacements saisonniers plus au nord restent mal connus.

ecology.en: Its broad bill has fine serrations that help strain food particles, and it overlaps geographically with the black-necked swan without belonging to the genus Cygnus.
ecology.fr: Son large bec finement dentelé aide à filtrer les particules alimentaires ; son aire recoupe celle du cygne à cou noir, sans qu’il appartienne au genre Cygnus.

conservation.en: The global status cited is Least Concern, although the patchy distribution makes local wetland loss and local disappearance relevant concerns.
conservation.fr: Le statut mondial cité est « préoccupation mineure », mais sa répartition discontinue rend importantes les pertes locales de zones humides et les disparitions locales.

title.fr: Coscoroba coscoroba — Liste rouge de l’UICN

facts: The global Red List assessment assigns Least Concern; the Swan Specialist Group separately discusses local habitat sensitivity.

uncertainties: The catalogue also includes Mute Swan and Whooper Swan; they are useful comparisons in body form, but the sources place Coscoroba in a separate genus and do not identify either as its closest relative.
Global LC status and local wetland pressures refer to different scales and should not be conflated.
review_note: Cross-checked the swan specialist account with Chilean government biodiversity information and the AZA waterfowl taxon group; used Mute Swan and Whooper Swan only as visual comparisons, not as asserted sister taxa.
